title: Embrace The Potato
description: Submerge yourself in an intense adventure as the famous Chinese archer hero and general, Hua Rong, known for his incredible accuracy with a bow and arrow. You are on a mission to rid the mountain of an evil army which has terrorized the local people.  Wield several different bows, special attacks, and magical attacks to defeat the army of foot soldiers, axe men, supernatural creatures, and more! You can unlock new weapons by earning more stars for each level, which are awarded for your accuracy and agility. The gameplay and controls are unlike any other game, specifically designed to mimic the feel of using a bow and arrow, yet easy to understand.  Truly experience the battlefields of ancient China in the Song Dynasty; pick up your bow and ready yourself for war!Features:?3D rendered graphics for amazing character detail and motion?Innovative tap and drag controls replace legacy on-screen joysticks?Unique control design provides a realistic archer experience in ancient Chinese battlefields?4 different stages?Over 10 different types of enemies?Boss fights for each stage?9 different bows to unlock, each with a unique damage type and special skill?Special magic attacks to blanket the field in destruction?Enemies and bosses have custom stats and skills requiring tactics to defeat themMinimum Device Requirements:    iPad 1, iPhone 3GS, iPod Touch (3rd generation)Recommended Devices:    iPad 2, iPad 3, iPhone 4, iPhone 4S, iPod Touch (4th generation)The game video is here:http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uF2D6OGmZJs
